summary: Re-read the apply path the interface finding rests on and recorded it as an anchor: the FSM loop calls applyBatch for every applied batch, applyBatch delegates to applySingle only when the FSM is not a BatchingFSM, and applySingle is the sole caller of StoreConfiguration — so a batching FSM has no path to that callback. The account's wording already matched the source, so nothing was corrected; the new source range makes the premise checkable at the exact lines, and the limitations list was reorganised so the command-coverage boundary is stated once, with the inference for DemoteVoter and Promote marked as read from the source rather than measured. No execution was requested. About twenty-five minutes of run time remain, and the state is settled: six questions each with accounts and receipts, four defects asserted (the verify quorum counting a non-voter with a demonstrated stale read; the non-voter transfer reporting success for a handover that cannot complete while the cluster stays leaderless for about 1.4 election timeouts; VerifyLeader futures stranded after Shutdown, pinned by a BatchApplyCh flip; StoreConfiguration never firing for a batching FSM, reproduced and measured across three commands), two leads refuted with counterevidence, and thirteen knowledge entries carrying the reusable Behaviours and Facts.
